question.text: Research analyst registration under SEBI regulations requires:

answer.text: NISM Series XV certification as one of the eligibility requirements
Only a graduate degree in any subject

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series XV page 7, associated persons of research analysts must pass the NISM-Series-XV examination to fulfil the requirements of Regulation 7(2). Pages 271-272 require appropriate qualification and certification for the activity of research analysis. The Trap: Certification is mandatory, not optional, and the certification specifically called out is NISM Series XV. Note: Per page 272, the relevant NISM certification must be kept current by obtaining a fresh relevant NISM certification before expiry, or within the specified period, as applicable.
